issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer reasonably give little weight to the December 2016 incident evidence?
issues.applicant_position: The officer unreasonably discounted family-sourced evidence as self-serving and faulted the lack of a police report.
issues.result_quote: I do not find that the PRRA officer reached an unreasonable result or failed to justify his decision in an intelligible manner.

issues.issue: Was a separate section 97 analysis required?
issues.applicant_position: A separate section 97 analysis was required and the officer did not conduct one.
issues.result_quote: There was no need to conduct a separate section 97 analysis

issues.issue: Should the officer have held a hearing under section 113(b)?
issues.applicant_position: The officer should have held a hearing under section 113(b) of IRPA.
issues.result_quote: I fail to see what purpose such a hearing would have served
